lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of roughly horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters. The clusters are smaller and more densely packed posterior to the branchial region, becoming larger and more widely spaced as they progress toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of circular blobs, forming a distinct grid-like lattice of anchor nodes across the central lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper lateral surface, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with a light upper edge and a shadowed ventral boundary.
